title: Vizhnitzer Rebbe Warns Antwerp
body: Vizhnitzer Rebbe of London issues a sharply worded letter to Antwerp's Jewish community, warning of weakened modesty standards and urging renewed commitment, particularly among women.

title: Rav Landau Condemns Arrest
body: Rav Dov Landau, Slabodka rosh yeshiva, sharply condemned the arrest and imprisonment of a yeshiva student by the Israeli Military Police, calling it a "horrific crime." He delivered a powerful address of chizuk at the Rabbeinu Chaim Ozer Yeshiva.
